caption: The drawing features two views of a rectangular, wooden box with decorative elements. The left side of the image shows the box opened, revealing a mirror set into the inside of the lid, which is propped up at an angle. The body of the box is brown with yellow or gold-colored decorative motifs, including a star and floral or ornate patterns on the sides and top. There is a small, round knob on a drawer at the front of the box. The right side of the drawing shows the closed lid from a top-down perspective, displaying a symmetrical gold-colored ornamental design in the center, flanked by smaller gold motifs in the corners and sides. The background of the drawing is a plain, light cream or off-white color, with no additional objects or scenes present.
title: Pa. German Toilet Box
